sloka: अवस्थाने यदा एव त्वम् आसिष्यसि परंतप ।तदा एव हरयः सर्वे त्यक्ष्यन्ति कृत निश्चयाः ॥४-५४-१६॥
transliteration: avasthāne yadā eva tvam āsiṣyasi paraṁtapa ।tadā eva harayaḥ sarve tyakṣyanti kṛta niścayāḥ ॥4-54-16॥

translations.english: 'O scorcher of enemies the moment you decide to establish yourself here, all these monkeys will surely desert you.
